subject: prd/self-drive-wake
statement: If an implementation await, configured-review obligation, or the checker exceeds its too-long threshold — including pending review reaching its consumer recovery bound, then the system shall surface it as a named non-resting defect in status and events; append immutable evidence before reporting exhaustion; an exhausted review stays pending/escalated until authenticated verification or explicit evidenced rearm
intent: a typed stale or exhausted row with age, provider attempts, recovery epoch/count/bound, last failure class, evidence ref, and remedy
fit_criterion: seeded stale implementation await, dead checker, pending review, exhausted review, and rearm fixtures flag at the exact threshold, retain/replay evidence, and never render idle/clean
